websiteEditor.title: Wedding website
websiteEditor.notSetUp: The website tables aren’t set up yet. Run the phase 8 migration (see README), then reload this page.
websiteEditor.offline: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection; we’ll keep your changes here.
websiteEditor.viewOnly: Only owners and editors can change the website. Here’s how it looks.
websiteEditor.livePreview: Live preview · {count, plural, one {# section showing} other {# sections showing}}

publish.title: Publish
publish.on: Anyone with the link can see your website.
publish.off: Only your wedding team can see it for now.
publish.addressHint: Changing it breaks links you’ve already shared (including the RSVP page).
publish.passwordSet: Password set. Guests who already entered the old one will be asked again.
publish.passwordText: Guests type it once (it’s remembered for 30 days). Your wedding team never needs it. Put it on your invitations.

design.lowContrast: This colour is light, so small text in it may be hard to read. A darker shade works better.
design.heroHint: The big photo at the top. Landscape photos work best (at least 1600 px wide).

classic.label: Classic
classic.description: Ivory, gold and serif type, centred and timeless.

modern.label: Modern Minimal
modern.description: Big bold type, black and white, lots of space.

garden.label: Garden
garden.description: Sage greens, soft paper and botanical sprigs.

beach.label: Beach
beach.description: Light blues, airy type and gentle waves.

hints.home: Your names, date, countdown and hero photo.
hints.story: How you met, with a timeline of milestones.
hints.events: Comes from Settings → Events: times, places, dress code.
hints.travel: Hotels marked “Show on website” plus your own tips.
hints.rsvp: Guests find their invitation by name or code.
hints.registry: Links to your gift lists or honeymoon fund.
hints.faq: Answers to the questions guests always ask.

forms.taglineHint: A short line above your names.
forms.homeNote: Names, date and place come from <link>Settings</link>. The hero photo is under Design.
forms.title: Title
forms.eventsNote: {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} from <link>Settings → Events</link> (times, places, dress code, with a map link).
forms.travelNote: {count, plural, one {# hotel shown} other {# hotels shown}} (tick “Show on website” in <hotels>Hotels</hotels>). The nearest airport comes from <travel>Travel</travel>.
forms.rsvpNote: Guests find their invitation by name or code. The deadline and meals are set in <link>RSVPs</link>.
forms.name: Name
forms.registryHint: e.g. “Your presence is the best gift, but if you’d like…”
forms.badUrl: That doesn’t look like a web address.
forms.questionsHint: Questions without an answer are hidden on the site.
forms.question: Question
forms.caption: Caption

image.wrongType: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
image.tooBig: That photo is larger than 10 MB. Please choose a smaller one.
